agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD responded that the final statement discusses the care taken in site planning and system design to provide harmony with surrounding communities, and that system designs generally attempt to meet conventional standards for good design.
text: Response: The final statement discusses the care taken in site planning and system design to provide this harmony. Note that the system designs generally attempt to meet conventional standards for good design.

closing_anchor: Note that the system designs generally attempt to meet conventional standards for good design.
